title: Historical Olist Curitiba cross-dock delay (PR to SP)
text: Historical Olist replay case: a PR to SP parcel encountered congestion at the Curitiba cross-dock with 15 hours remaining to SLA. Operations approved a priority carrier escalation and a BRL 20.00 goodwill voucher draft. Carrier expedited sorting, preventing a 1-star negative review, and delivery was successfully fulfilled 28 hours later.

title: Campinas SP seller dispatch exception to Salvador BA
text: Historical Olist case: an electronics shipment from Campinas (seller with 22.7% late dispatch rate and 5 recent exceptions) was delayed at origin. Policy POL_SELLER_DISPATCH_DELAY_03 was triggered. Operations approved carrier escalation and a BRL 25.00 customer retention credit draft, mitigating severe customer dissatisfaction.

title: São Paulo to Manaus long-distance corridor bottleneck
text: Historical Olist case: a high-value telephony parcel from São Paulo to Manaus, AM faced interstate transit delay with <18 hours to promised delivery. Operations initiated Correios SEDEX priority sorting escalation and prepared an empathetic customer status update draft, successfully retaining customer trust.
